title: Private Vancouver City Adventure: Outdoor Escape Room for Kids
includes: Use of one superhero game kit per team during the game.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Do NOT go to any location without receiving a message from us. We will send you your starting location leading up to your game day. If you do not receive anything 24 hours before your game, contact us. Our phone and email is listed online.
Children must be accompanied by an adult
A minimum of 7 people per booking is required
A maximum of 40 people per booking
Wear comfortable walking shoes for a 2 - 2.5 km walk
Bring reading glasses if you require them
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately

Wheelchairs/Strollers: this game route includes elevators. If they are out of service this game may not be accessible for everyone. Please contact us in advance and we can check for you or recommend a different game.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get some fresh air (and zero screen time) and burn off some energy in downtown Vancouver. 

Team up in teams of superheroes to save the planet and stop the supervillain Muck Monster! This outdoor escape room mystery game is *real* fun - there is no app to download, no wifi or devices required. You'll be too busy exploring the city and admiring scenic Coal Harbour to look at your phone (but don't forget to take photos)! 

Groups are divided into teams (maximum 5 players). A fun family activity or activity or a group of kids (one adult must accompany each team). A real person, Agent X, will meet you at the start and end of your superhero quest with everything you need to play. We supply the game kits (clues, artifacts, map, tools), you save the planet on your very own private superhero quest! 

Each team receives a team certificate with their score and each player receives a souvenir sticker. Food courts and family friendly restaurants nearby.
